title: Proposed ARX security CI separation for a future release
global_constraints: No security workflow publishes packages or GitHub releases.
No security workflow signs artifacts without a distinct protected human gate.
Default permissions are contents: read; write permissions are isolated to a future attestation job.
Actions and tool versions are pinned and reviewed before activation.
Untrusted pull requests never receive environments, credentials, signing material, or OIDC write permissions.

jobs.name: dependency-and-cve
jobs.scope: Build metadata and exact supported dependency closures
jobs.failure_policy: Fail on unresolved HIGH or CRITICAL findings; never auto-upgrade or suppress.

jobs.name: sbom
jobs.failure_policy: Fail on invalid syntax, missing exact package identity, secret-shaped content, or local-path leakage.

jobs.name: sast
jobs.failure_policy: Preserve findings; require review of every HIGH or CRITICAL finding. Do not rewrite code merely to silence a scanner.

jobs.name: secret-scan
jobs.scope: Tracked source and staged public artifact contents
jobs.failure_policy: Fail closed on credential material; do not print matched secret values.

jobs.name: artifact-integrity
jobs.failure_policy: Require expected names, package/version identity, strict package checks, and an internally valid checksum manifest.

jobs.name: provenance-verification
jobs.failure_policy: Read-only verification; never create, replace, upload, sign, or publish an artifact.

campaigns: second-engine malware scanning of copied artifacts
bounded fuzz campaigns against ARX-owned parsers and local inputs
installer lifecycle tests in a disposable Windows VM
destructive tamper tests on copied artifacts only
prohibited: third-party binary uploads without explicit approval

future_artifact_attestation_gate.sbom_association: Associate the validated CycloneDX SBOM where GitHub support and the reviewed action interface permit it.
future_artifact_attestation_gate.ordering: Attest exact reviewed build outputs before release upload; verify subjects and digests before publication.
future_artifact_attestation_gate.beta_1_policy: Do not recreate or replace Beta 1 artifacts merely to add attestations.

future_production_signing_gate.separation: Distinct manually dispatched workflow or offline procedure with a protected environment and required reviewers; never part of automatic pull-request CI.
requirements: trusted production code-signing certificate or justified hardware-backed signing service
new checksums and provenance bound to the signed bytes
